content:
Hi Maria. Want to color with me?
Sure, Sandra. I love to color.
This is blue. It's my favorite color.
I like blue, too.
What's your favorite color?
I don't know, maybe pink.
Here, try this pink. It's pretty.
Yes, it is. It's perfect!
